scope: Manual reads of the SmartyCam overlay LAP timer, used to map ffmpeg presentation time (PTS) to each lap's true start. Observation only; no frames are stored.
method: ffmpeg -ss <pts> -i <video> (accurate input seek, PTS base). Read the overlay 'LAP n m:ss.ss' at 10/50/90 % of every lap. Offset = mean(read - predicted). The overlay updates about every 50 ms, so reads trail the true value by 0-50 ms.
timeBaseWarning: OpenCV CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC seeking on the 7/29 file returns the frame 1.000 s (30 frames) later than requested (requested 219.7 s -> timer 0:50.02 via OpenCV vs 0:49.02 via ffmpeg; 513.9 s -> 0:54.99 vs 0:53.99). The older 'video = L3 t + 458.9 s' mapping is in the OpenCV base; in PTS base the 7/29 L3 true start is about 459.89 s.
overlayLapNumber: overlay lap = data lap + 1 (overlay lap 1 is the out lap).
